summary: Copper Lane Kitchen & Bar earns consistent praise for its braised short rib, its cocktails, and server Dana, with several reviewers returning specifically for her. Weekend service is the main complaint, with long waits for food and drinks, understaffing, reservation mix-ups, and a serious gluten-free miss that a celiac guest reported. Secondary concerns include patio music volume, prices, bland fish tacos, and washroom upkeep.
themes: Slow weekend service and long waits
action_items: Investigate the celiac guest's gluten-free incident (risotto thickened with flour) and retrain all staff on allergen procedures and what counts as gluten-free
Clearly mark gluten-free items on the menu and confirm allergen info with the kitchen before servers answer
Review weekend staffing levels, especially Saturday and Sunday brunch, to reduce waits for food and drink orders
Fix the online booking sync and host records to stop double-booked or missing reservations
Keep a backup supply plan for short rib so guests are not turned away after long waits
Follow up with the guest who found a hair in their pasta and reinforce management response to food issues
Lower patio music volume after 8 PM or set a limit, since guests have asked twice
Check washroom supplies and cleaning schedule, including paper towels and wet floors
Re-examine the fish taco recipe and seasoning
Communicate the reasons for price increases or review value on the short rib and other entrées
